m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Thank the sands. If I have to listen to more weeping, I'll vomit. I don't know which is worse, the Baron's madness, or the Baroness's sorrow.
Teddy is truly the only hope for House Calixco, and your alliance. Freeing her though would be impossible... unless... hmm. Let's talk outside.
The Baroness knows the Baron must be overthrown, but she's squeamish - best not to talk in there. Now, about Istanboa...
Centuries ago, after the reign of the Purrzians and Overlord Xerxes, the Serpentine Empire rose to power and ruled Mirage with an Iron Fang.
Ew... and it's a good thing they were defeated. I can't stand Snakes... did I tell you that already? I would never serve a Serpent Master.
How very interesting. Anyway, after they were defeated, the Serpentines fled into the underground city of Istanboa and hid the entrance.
To rescue Teddy, you first need to find that entrance. A band of Mongus has taken refuge in a cavern across the Basin. They may know how.
The Mongus are wary of outsiders, but they are mortal enemies of the Serpentines, so they might help. Best of luck to you.
That must be the Mongu Refuge over there. You should know, Master, some say the Mongus were the greatest warriors in the history of Mirage.
The Serpentines had subjugated everyone, even the noble houses - total scaredy-Qhats. But the Mongus were immune to the Serpentines' venom.
So the Mongus marched across Mirage slicing the Serpentines into ribbons. After that, they set up the Mottoman Empire... or something like that.
All that history stuff is confusing, you know? What matters is they can help us, I guess, so... off we go. All right, Master. I'll follow you.
Who dares enter the Refuge of the Mongu Warriors? Ah, of course! It's an Outsider from another world. Otherwise, you would know better.
I am sorry to tell you, however, that your ignorance will not afford you a free pass. Allowing trespassers would destroy our credibility.
No, I'm afraid that, like so many who came before, you must give me an opportunity to freshen up my combat skills. En garde!
I admit, your magic is more than a match for my blades, but I have a secret - my brother Tiki - he is older and more skilled.
We will await you in the next chamber and together, we will be your downfall!
Yes, little brother. I see what you are saying. I welcome this challenge. It is an excellent opportunity for me to teach you some new tactics.
Come at us, Wizard. We are always eager to test our skills, particularly against a foe we have never faced.
Great sands! I underestimated this combatant. I hope you learned something though, Ricky. This is an excellent lesson.
Wizard, you are formidable, but you have still not dueled the primo warrior in our family. With our older brother Taffy, we will defeat you yet!
Oh yes! How delightful! A new, tasty morsel to slice up with my blades. I would take you myself, but my brothers clearly need more practice.
You will find this battle considerably more complex than the last two. Approach and take a bite of Taffy!
You have great prowess, Wizard. You have earned the respect of the Mongus, and that is no small thing. Now, what do you want with us?
You want to break someone out of a Snakish Prison in Istanboa? Why didn't you say so? You have come to the right place. Let's talk outside.
My brothers and I have discussed your delicious request and unanimously decided; we would be delighted to help liberate someone from Istanboa.
He doesn't even trust his own Qhittens! When they reach the age of adulthood, he sends them into exile! I don't have the strength to stop him.
One of our daughters - Teddy - she had the strength, but he had her thrown into a Snakish Prison in Istanboa! Oh, I'm too sad to talk any more.
I can't believe I told you all that... oh, I'm so sad... so, so sad...
